title: Live Wire (Pete McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal electric energy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You walk into the room, you don't walk in — you arrive
Some people light a lamp, Pete hooks up the live
Seven years on Corey, more on Joel below
But age don't slow the current, it just changes how it flows

[Verse 2]
Up a ladder with a nail gun, laughing at the height
Pelican on the stern now, laughing at the light
Same voltage, different circuit — the man don't lose his charge
Whether he's on a rooftop or a boat out on the barge

[Chorus]
Live wire, live wire
He comes in hot and the room gets higher
Oldest one, the one who set the bar
Pete McIvor — that's who you are

[Bridge]
Chas used to joke — boy, slow down
But Chas knew better — no live wire needs a crown
He just needs the water, he just needs the sky
You can't turn off a live wire — you can only watch him fly

[Verse 3]
He followed you on Suno — did you think we wouldn't see?
Pelican Charters Perth, that's Pete, that's family
We made these songs for you, mate, even if you didn't know
Oldest brother watching — there he is, hello

[Outro]
Live wire
Live wire
That's my boy
That's my boy
